requirements.title: Required courses
requirements.summary: Complete all listed courses, totaling the published 15 semester credit hours.

requirements.title: Completion GPA
requirements.summary: Earn an overall GPA of at least 2.0 in the minor courses.

requirements.title: Enrollment eligibility
requirements.summary: Overall GPA must be at least 3.00; complete 24 credit hours, including at least 12 at Texas A&M.

requirements.title: Declaration
requirements.summary: Declare through the major college or department; students are encouraged to begin courses once declared.

requirements.title: Graduation and recognition
requirements.summary: A declared minor becomes a graduation requirement. It is recorded on the transcript after graduation, not on the diploma.

requirements.title: Upper-level minimum
requirements.summary: At least 6 hours must be at the 300–400 level.

notes: Complete refers to the published minor requirements and policies. Catalog eligibility controls this record: 24 completed hours including 12 at Texas A&M. This differs from the simpler threshold on the separately inspected department page.

2026-10-11 metadata review: all five course descriptions are summarized from the BUSN catalog. BUSN 460/465/470 explicitly require the AI in Business minor and junior or senior classification. BUSN 250/255 have no prerequisite statement on the inspected course page; null does not assert unrestricted access. Semester-hour labels remain supported by the minor requirement table. The overview is a program aim, not an assessed learning-outcome claim. Neither inspected program page establishes first offering; date remains unknown.
